rules.answer:
Hardware Issues:

1. Keyboard Issue
2. Monitor Display Issue
3. Mouse Trackpad Issue
4. Power Battery Issue
5. Overheating Fan Issue
6. Audio Speaker Mic Issue
7. Storage Hard Drive Issue
8. RAM Performance Issue

To fix keyboard issues:
1. Reconnect USB cable or Bluetooth device.
2. Test on another USB port.
3. Uninstall driver in Device Manager and restart PC.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix display issues:
1. Reconnect HDMI/DisplayPort cables.
2. Reset graphics driver using Win + Ctrl + Shift + B.
3. Adjust resolution settings in Display Settings.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix mouse or trackpad issues:
1. Clean optical sensor underneath or replace wireless batteries.
2. Ensure touchpad isn't disabled via Fn key.
3. Reinstall driver in Device Manager.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix power and battery issues:
1. Check charger and wall outlet power.
2. Perform hard reset by holding power button for 15 seconds.
3. Check power plan settings in Control Panel.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix overheating issues:
1. Keep air vents clear of dust.
2. Close heavy background tasks in Task Manager.
3. Use laptop on a hard, flat surface.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix audio issues:
1. Check sound output/input device in Sound Settings.
2. Ensure volume is unmuted.
3. Reinstall audio drivers in Device Manager.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix storage issues:
1. Run 'chkdsk /f' in CMD as Administrator.
2. Check Disk Management (diskmgmt.msc) to verify drive detection.
3. Reseat internal storage drive cable.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix RAM issues:
1. Run Windows Memory Diagnostic (mdsched.exe).
2. Reseat RAM sticks carefully into slots.
3. Test RAM modules individually.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

Software Issues:

1. App Crashing Issue
2. Windows Update Issue
3. Slow Performance Issue
4. Install Uninstall Issue
5. Virus Security Issue
6. Blue Screen BSOD Issue
7. Browser Internet Issue
8. File Corruption DLL Issue
9. Printer Software Issues
10. SAP / ERP Issues

To fix app crashes:
1. Force end task in Task Manager (Ctrl + Shift + Esc).
2. Update application to latest version.
3. Clear cache or reinstall app.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix Windows update errors:
1. Run Windows Update Troubleshooter in Settings.
2. Clear cache in C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution.
3. Restart Windows Update service in services.msc.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix slow performance:
1. Disable startup programs in Task Manager.
2. Clear temporary files using Disk Cleanup (%temp%).
3. Restart your computer.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix setup errors:
1. Run installer as Administrator.
2. Temporarily disable third-party antivirus.
3. Use Microsoft Program Install Troubleshooter.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix virus threats:
1. Run Full Scan using Windows Defender.
2. Disconnect internet if suspicious activity occurs.
3. Run Malwarebytes scan.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix BSOD errors:
1. Note down Stop Code.
2. Boot in Safe Mode.
3. Uninstall recently installed drivers or updates.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix browser issues:
1. Clear cookies, cache, and history.
2. Disable browser extensions.
3. Flush DNS in CMD (ipconfig /flushdns).
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix corrupted files:
1. Run 'sfc /scannow' in CMD as Administrator.
2. Run 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth'.
3. Reinstall program requesting DLL.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

Printer Software Issues:

1. Paper Jam Issue
2. Printer Offline Spooler Issue
3. Print Quality Issue
4. Printer Wireless Driver Issue
5. Stuck Print Queue Issue
6. Cartridge Toner Issue
7. Scanner Utility Issue
8. IP Network Port Issue

SAP / ERP Issues:
1. SAP GUI Installation / Setup
2. SAP Login & Password Reset
3. SAP Connection / Server Timeout
4. SAP Authorization / T-Code Access Error
5. SAP Printing & Spool Issues
6. SAP Performance / Slow Response
7. SAP System Dump / Runtime Error
8. SAP License Expiry Issue
9. Generate Ticket to IT Support

Printer Issues:

1. Paper Jam Issue
2. Printer Offline Spooler Issue
3. Print Quality Issue
4. Printer Wireless Driver Issue
5. Stuck Print Queue Issue
6. Cartridge Toner Issue
7. Scanner Utility Issue
8. IP Network Port Issue

To fix paper jam:
1. Power off printer.
2. Remove stuck paper gently from tray or rear door.
3. Fan paper stack before reloading.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix offline spooler errors:
1. Restart printer and PC.
2. Restart 'Print Spooler' in services.msc.
3. Uncheck 'Use Printer Offline' in Printer properties.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix print quality:
1. Check ink/toner levels.
2. Run Head Cleaning in printer software.
3. Ensure paper type matches print dialog settings.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix Wi-Fi driver setup:
1. Reconnect printer via Wi-Fi Setup Wizard or WPS button.
2. Download latest manufacturer drivers (HP, Epson, Canon).
3. Re-add printer in Settings > Bluetooth & Devices.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To clear stuck queue:
1. Run CMD as Administrator.
2. Type 'net stop spooler'.
3. Delete files in 'C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS'.
4. Type 'net start spooler'.
5. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix cartridge toner errors:
1. Remove cartridge and check if protective tape is removed.
2. Clean copper contacts gently.
3. Reinsert cartridge firmly until it clicks.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix scanner errors:
1. Restart WIA (Windows Image Acquisition) in services.msc.
2. Reinstall scanner software utility.
3. Connect USB cable directly to PC.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix printer IP port errors:
1. Print Network Config page from printer to check current IP.
2. Open Printer Properties > Ports tab.
3. Match Standard TCP/IP Port address with printer IP.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

Computer Issues:

1. Computer Not Turning On
2. Slow Computer Performance
3. Computer Freezing Issue
4. Computer Overheating Issue
5. Computer Blue Screen BSOD
6. Computer No Display Issue
7. Computer Random Reboot
8. Computer Virus Infection

To fix power issues:
1. Check power cable and wall socket.
2. Ensure power switch on PSU is turned ON.
3. Hold power button for 15 seconds to discharge static.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix slow computer:
1. Open Task Manager and disable heavy startup apps.
2. Clear temp files using Disk Cleanup (%temp%).
3. Upgrade RAM or switch to SSD.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix freezing issues:
1. Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to close unresponsive apps.
2. Update graphics and system drivers.
3. Run Windows Memory Diagnostic.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix overheating:
1. Clean dust from internal fans and vents.
2. Ensure proper airflow around computer cabinet.
3. Re-apply thermal paste on processor.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix BSOD crashes:
1. Note down error code.
2. Boot in Safe Mode and uninstall recent updates or drivers.
3. Run 'sfc /scannow' in CMD as Administrator.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix display issues:
1. Reconnect HDMI/DisplayPort cable securely.
2. Clean RAM sticks and reinsert them properly.
3. Test with another monitor or cable.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To fix random restarts:
1. Turn off 'Automatically restart' in Advanced System Settings.
2. Check power supply unit (PSU) performance.
3. Monitor CPU/GPU temperatures.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

To remove virus infections:
1. Run Full System Scan using Windows Defender.
2. Scan with Malwarebytes in Safe Mode.
3. Clear temporary files and browser extensions.
4. If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP GUI Installation Help:
• Download the latest SAP GUI setup from the internal IT portal.
• Run installer as Administrator.
• Re-add Server Connection details if missing.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP Login & Password Reset:
• Use the Self-Service Password Reset Portal to unlock your account.
• Incorrect attempts lock the ID for 30 minutes automatically.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP Connection Timeout Help:
• Check your internet or VPN connection.
• Verify if saplogon.ini file path is correctly mapped.
• Restart SAP Logon Pad.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP Authorization / Access Issue:
• Run T-Code '/nSU53' right after receiving the error.
• Take a screenshot of the missing authorization object.
• Raise a ticket attached with the SU53 screenshot.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP Printing & Spool Help:
• Check Spool status using T-Code '/nSP01'.
• Ensure local default printer is online and set in SAP User Defaults (SU3).
• Restart SAP LPD service if stuck.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP Performance / Slow Response:
• Limit the date range/criteria in your query report.
• Execute heavy reports in Background Mode (F9).
• Clear SAP GUI cache files.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP System Dump / ABAP Error:
• Note down the short dump error code.
• Check T-Code '/nST22' for runtime error logs.
• Forward the dump summary to the SAP ABAP/Basis team.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

SAP License Expiry Issue:
• Contact IT Basis Team to update the SAP License Key.
• Check system hardware key validity via T-Code '/nSLIC'.
• If not able to fix, please contact the IT team.

Generate Ticket to IT Support:
• Click the button below or visit the IT Portal to raise an incident.
• Provide your SAP User ID, System ID (SID), and exact Error Code / Screenshot.
• Link: https://itsupport.portal/raise-ticket
